expression: (http.user_agent contains "sqlmap") or (http.user_agent contains "nikto") or (http.user_agent contains "nmap") or (http.user_agent contains "masscan") or (http.user_agent contains "acunetix") or (http.user_agent contains "nessus") or (http.user_agent contains "openvas") or (http.user_agent contains "wpscan") or (http.user_agent contains "dirbuster") or (http.user_agent contains "gobuster") or (http.user_agent contains "feroxbuster") or (http.user_agent contains "ffuf") or (http.user_agent contains "hydra") or (http.user_agent contains "havij") or (http.user_agent contains "morfeus") or (http.user_agent contains "zgrab") or (http.user_agent contains "l9scan") or (http.user_agent contains "researchscan") or (http.user_agent eq "") or (lower(http.user_agent) contains "python-requests" and not http.request.uri.path matches "^/api/(public|webhooks)/")
notes: Active-recon and pentest tooling fingerprints. The trailing python-requests guard avoids false-positives for legitimate webhook callers — adjust to match your real ingestion paths. Keep this rule above the Cloudflare Managed Ruleset so blocks count toward your firewall analytics with this description.

OFAC-sanctioned regions plus Crimea and the LPR/DPR oblasts (UA-43 Crimea, UA-09 Luhansk, UA-14 Donetsk). Verify against your legal counsel — sanctions lists change. Switch action to 'managed_challenge' first if you have legitimate users in any of these regions and need a soft block.

Most JSON APIs only need GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE/OPTIONS/HEAD. WebDAV verbs and TRACE are common probe vectors and almost never legitimate. Tighten the path prefix to your real API root if it isn't /api/.

expression: (http.request.uri.path contains "/.well-known/security.txt") or (http.request.uri.path contains "/robots.txt" and http.request.method ne "GET") or (http.request.uri.path matches "(?i)/(admin|administrator|wp-admin|console|dashboard|manage|portal)") or (http.request.uri.query contains "=eval(") or (http.request.uri.query contains "=base64_") or (http.request.uri.query contains "<script")
notes: Surface admin-path probes and obvious injection payloads in firewall events without blocking, so you can build a baseline before flipping the action to 'managed_challenge' or 'block'. The 'log' action requires Pro+; on Free, change to 'managed_challenge' or skip this rule.
